_source: Script v2 (design/script_v2.md d9; applied 5 Oct 2026). A2 (PLAN.md proposals, approved by Garv 5 Oct): the final accusation after the Archive escape, before the Finale. One card per witness, then name who caused the incident. The Archive's three documents (case request, apprentice log, the player's own casebook) are shown automatically. Every slot accepts core evidence, so anyone who reached 9/9 can answer. Feedback: slots are judged first ({n} of 3 hold); the conclusion is judged only once all three hold. No penalty, nothing locks.
title: WHO CAUSED THE INCIDENT?
question: Who caused the incident?
intro: One card from each witness. Then name them.

archiveClue.title: THE ARCHIVE
archiveClue.text: The case request, the apprentice log and this casebook: one hand.

documents.title: CASE REQUEST
documents.text: Veyra stopped at 2:17. Someone has to remember it.

documents.title: APPRENTICE LOG
documents.text:
Anchors bind in fourteen minutes.
- E. Vane

documents.title: MY CASEBOOK
documents.text: The rope never moved. The bell rang anyway.

conclusions.text: Elias Vane, the apprentice, still out there somewhere.
Hanna, keeper of the lantern records.
No one. It was an accident.

reactions.me: Every card pointed at the one witness I never questioned.
reactions.elias_out: The name is right. Look whose hand wrote these notes.
reactions.leela: Hanna said stop. The log says who didn't.
reactions.lantern: The lantern did what it was told. Who told it?
reactions.accident: Accidents don't ignore a warning, then erase themselves.

feedback.pickFirst: Pick one card from each witness, then name who did it.
feedback.slotsHold: {n} of 3 witness cards hold. Look again at what they saw.
